prompt: A single haunting image representing youth suicide as a global crisis. Show silhouettes of young people (teenagers and young adults) arranged in a grid or crowd formation, fading from vibrant color on the left to grayscale/translucent on the right—suggesting invisible loss, presence becoming absence. The background is a world map in muted tones, with certain regions slightly highlighted in red. The composition should feel like a gallery photograph documenting absence, not a chart. Cold, documentary tone. Silent. Dignified. No text, no numbers, no axes, no labels. Editorial photography style, fine art sensibility. Negative: do NOT use: melting, thermometers, skulls, bones, danger symbols, medical imagery, bright colors, infographic style, charts, graphs, sad faces, tears, or obvious death metaphors. Avoid clichés. Keep it subtle and powerful.
dataset_name: WHO Global Health Observatory - Suicide Mortality Rate
insight: Suicide is the leading cause of death for people aged 15–29 globally, killing more young people annually than war, accidents, or communicable diseases combined.
